newsitem.title: UK: Rothschild launches UK student loan privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Rothschild launches UK student loan privatisation.

text.p: Investment bank N M Rothschild & Sons said on Friday it has launched the privatisation of the British government's student loan debt.
The bank said in a statement that the sale -- of 1.6 billion stg out of around 2.5 billion stg of outstanding loans -- is expected to be completed by the Autumn.
Rothschild has asked potential bidders to register their interest by March 14.
Rothschild said the first sale was likely to be followed by sales of around one billion stg every year.

"Given the advantageous terms offered to the student borrowers, a package of Government-backed payments will be offered to enhance the return on the assets to a commercial level," said Rothschild executive director Charles Keay.
He added that the sale will be structured in such a way as to ensure a significant level of the underlying risk is transferred to the private sector.
Rothschild said the sale would have no practical effect on the student borrowers.
